verdict: Nasi ayam is slightly better. Protein is about the same, but calories and fat are lower.
why: Nasi ayam is about 600 kcal, nasi lemak ayam goreng is about 650 kcal.
Protein is almost the same: about 28 g for nasi ayam, 30 g for nasi lemak ayam goreng.
Nasi lemak ayam goreng has about 30 g of fat versus 23 g for nasi ayam, from the santan (coconut milk), sambal and fried chicken.
Both get high in calories if you add extra rice or chicken skin, so portion still matters.
when_a: Nasi lemak ayam goreng is okay when it's your main meal of the day and your breakfast or dinner is lighter.
when_b: Nasi ayam suits a workday lunch, even better if you pick roasted or steamed chicken.
tip: Choose roasted or steamed chicken for your nasi ayam, remove some of the skin, and ask for extra vegetables or cucumber.

faq.q: Is steamed chicken rice better than roasted chicken rice?
faq.a: Steamed chicken usually has slightly less fat. But the difference is small. Removing the skin makes a bigger difference.

faq.q: Can I ask for less rice?
faq.a: Yes, and it's highly encouraged. Ask for half rice and keep the chicken. You still feel full with fewer calories.
